Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side:
- You’re evaluating a user-facing summarization feature for care teams (target Q3 launch).
- Primary constraints: sub-200ms 95th percentile latency, SOC2 evidence for audit, and keep per-request cost predictable.
- We proposed a Dedicated plan for steady throughput + a fallback hosted option for spikes.

I attached the estimate we talked through (Estimate_AveryHealth_Q2_2027.pdf) with a line-item breakdown and a short appendix on expected latency/cost assumptions. Can you confirm you received the PDF?

If it’s helpful I can walk you and the procurement team through the numbers — I typically keep this to 15–20 minutes. Slots I have this week:
- Wed 2027-04-07 10:00–10:20 PT
- Thu 2027-04-08 13:30–13:50 PT
- Fri 2027-04-09 09:30–09:50 PT

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll send a calendar invite. Marissa (cc’d) can jump in on procurement/contracting items.

Attachments: Estimate_AveryHealth_Q2_2027.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
